html:
G'oya

Bu pivot: qatorlarda turgan choraklarni ustunlarga aylantirish. Hudud bo'yicha guruhlaymiz va har bir chorak uchun alohida SUM yozamiz. Har bir SUM ichidagi CASE faqat o'z choragiga tegishli savdoni o'tkazadi, qolganlari uchun 0 beradi.

Yechim

SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q1,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q2,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q3,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q4
FROM sales
GROUP BY region

Toshkentning yanvar va fevraldagi savdosi q1 ga tushadi: 500 + 300 = 800. Buxoroda faqat dekabr bor, qolgan uchta chorak 0.

Tuzoqlar

ELSE 0 siz Buxoroning q1, q2, q3 ustunlari NULL bo'ladi: guruhda bu choraklarga mos qator yo'q, SUM esa faqat NULL lardan 0 emas, NULL yasaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN amount END) AS q1,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN amount END) AS q2,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN amount END) AS q3,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN amount END) AS q4
FROM sales
GROUP BY region

Chegaralarni < bilan yozganda bitta oy yonidagi chorakka o'tib ketishi oson: month < 3 bilan mart 2-chorakka tushadi. BETWEEN ikkala chetni ham o'z ichiga oladi, shuning uchun bu yerda qulay.

Boshqa yo'l

Chorak raqamini butun sonli bo'lish bilan hisoblash mumkin: (month + 2) / 3 yanvar, fevral va mart uchun 1, aprel uchun 2 beradi. Keyin oddiy CASE qoladi:

SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE (month + 2) / 3 WHEN 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q1,
       SUM(CASE (month + 2) / 3 WHEN 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q2,
       SUM(CASE (month + 2) / 3 WHEN 3 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q3,
       SUM(CASE (month + 2) / 3 WHEN 4 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q4
FROM sales
GROUP BY region
